title: Nostalgic British Leek Gratin
description: A buttery, springy and comforting British-style leek gratin that is egg-free and perfect for any hearty meal.
instructions: Clean and slice the leeks into 1 cm thick rings.
Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat and add the leeks, sautéing until softened, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Sprinkle the flour over the leeks, stir well, and cook for 1 minute to eliminate raw flour taste.
Gradually whisk in the milk, cooking until the sauce thickens and coats the back of a spoon, about 4 to 6 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg, then stir in half of the grated cheddar until melted.
Transfer the leek mixture to a greased baking dish.
Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese evenly over the top.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the remaining butter and scatter over the cheese.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden and bubbly, then let rest 5 minutes before serving.
